name: Mycopsychosys
source:
In this game, you will experience the horrors of a sporestorm, a new weather phenomenon that is becoming too common in the whole country of Spain. Heavy clouds that contain Mycopsychosis spores are approaching your area. If you want to survive, you have to stay inside your home and closely follow the PCD (plague control department) issued rules.

Meet our small but charismatic cast of characters, engage and take care of them.

[From [url=https://delta-cat-studio.itch.io/mycopsychosys]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你将体验孢子风暴的恐怖，这是一种在西班牙全国变得越来越普遍的新天气现象。含有支原体病孢子的厚云正在接近你所在的地区。如果你想生存，就必须待在家里并严格遵守PCD（鼠疫控制部门）发布的规则。

认识我们人数不多但魅力十足的角色，与他们互动并照顾他们。

[来自[url=https://delta-cat-studio.itch.io/mycopsychosys]itch.io[/url]]
